name: Haha to Kodomobeya Oji-san no 1￮ Nenkan no Nariyuki to, Sorekara.
original_name: 母と子供部屋おじさんの1○年間の成り行きと、それから。
source:
At thirty, Yoshizawa Hiroto,  the man still living in his childhood room...

And his mother, Yoshizawa Rie, with whom he shares a secret relationship...

How did their current relationship come to be...

This story traces their secret bond with his mother—past, present, and beyond— delving into his past, starting from his elementary school days when he attended school normally despite his introverted nature.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ320184.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
三十岁了，吉泽宏人，那个还住在儿时房间里的男人……

还有与他有着秘密关系的母亲吉泽理惠……

他们现在的关系是怎么变成这样的……

这个故事追溯了他们与他母亲的秘密联系——过去、现在和以后——深入研究他的过去，从他的小学时代开始，当时他尽管性格内向，但仍正常上学。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ320184.html]DLsite[/url]]
